failing_job_findings.cause: test_first_party_roots_include_hot_reload_include_paths: Windows path-joining bug in this PR's own first_party_roots() -- the assembled include-path result concatenates a drive letter fragment ('D:/a/reflex/reflex/C') instead of the resolved sibling path, so the assertion mismatches. Real bug in the PR's REFLEX_HOT_RELOAD_INCLUDE_PATHS code, Windows-specific.

test_wait_for_compile_respects_lock, test_owns_compilation_follows_the_daemon_marker, test_pid_alive_distinguishes_live_and_exited_processes: all in tests/units/utils/test_compile_daemon.py, all failing on Windows lock/PID-liveness timing for the PR's new compile_daemon module (e.g. wait_for_compile not returning promptly after a dead-holder pid; daemon_active()/_pid_alive() misreporting after a process exits). Same pattern across all 5 windows-latest jobs (3.10-3.14), 4 failures each -- consistent, real Windows compile-daemon bugs, not flaky.
